progression.narrative: The performance opens on G3 and dwells most on G in Phrase 1. Phrase 4 (1:02.0) introduces Bb, centred on G. Phrase 5 (1:40.7) introduces C, centred on C. Phrase 11 (2:60.0) introduces Ak, centred on C. The line peaks at C5 (546.7 Hz) at 2:55.7. It closes on the tonic (G3 → Bb3 → G3 → Ak3 → G3 → G3).
